v0.23.1: fetch full history before advancing the v1 Action ref

notes: This release fixes the release workflow step that advances the rolling `v1` ref of the GitHub Action (`yeongseon/azure-functions-doctor@v1`). That ref is separate from the Python package version: the package is versioned `0.23.1`, and `v1` is a moving Action major ref. Before the fix, advancing `v1` after the 0.23.0 release was rejected as non-fast-forward (#574).
